summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $4.25B senior unsecured notes offering across four tranches: EUR1.25B 5.200% notes due 2029, EUR1.0B 5.550% notes due 2032, EUR1.0B 6.250% notes due 2038, and EUR1.0B 6.650% notes due 2045. Settlement is expected September 14, 2026, with semi-annual interest payments beginning March 14, 2027, and optional redemption at make-whole prices plus tax-redemption rights. Nasdaq Bond Exchange listing is intended. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation.
